judged_text: The sync branch returns the raw fetch Response while all seven call sites were written against the provider-specific shapes the default branch returns (gaxios res.data for Google, a HubspotToken object for HubSpot, an axios response with .data for Zoho CRM/Bigin, provider-envelope JSON for the Lark/Zoom/MS handlers). Setting CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT crashes Google refresh with TypeError (token = res?.data is undefined on a fetch Response, then token.access_token), crashes Zoho CRM/Bigin evaluating tokenInfo.data.error on undefined, makes HubSpot store undefined token fields, and feeds Lark/Zoom handlers bodies in the wrong shape — the credential-sync feature fails at runtime for most apps the moment it is enabled.
